g.text: GTA-AVT gdf-joint-r3: final native VAL8 endpoints with F reference
Final AR / AR_GDF use prescribed LAST; F is the unchanged base reference | Single seed 20261032
Whiskers in A are population SD across eight cases, not seed variation or confidence intervals. Points in B/C are recorded native case scores.
Native endpoints use a separate evaluation protocol from fixed-patch VAL. F-to-final changes include extra training and are not budget-matched component ablations.
